import asyncio
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Sequence


# CASE g_comment_line_before_for expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    # Run one chunk at a time; each chunk runs in parallel.
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_trailing_comment_on_for expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):  # one chunk per pass
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_trailing_comment_on_gather expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )  # noqa: E501


# CASE g_method_self expect=pass
class Runner:
    async def map_with_concurrency[T](self, items, width, operation):
        for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            )


# CASE g_staticmethod expect=pass
class Jobs:
    @staticmethod
    async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
        for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            )


# CASE g_return_none expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](
    items: Sequence[T], width: int, operation: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]]
) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_default_width_four expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](
    items: Sequence[T], operation: Callable[[T], Awaitable[None]], width: int = 4
) -> None:
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_type_default_313 expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T = int](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_single_line_doc expect=pass
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    """Run operation over items, width at a time."""
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )


# CASE g_return_results_impostor expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )
    for item in items:
        await operation(item)


# CASE g_comment_then_extra expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )
        # audit each chunk
        await operation(items[offset])


# CASE g_extra_before_loop expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency[T](items, width, operation):
    await operation(items[0])
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
        )
